sectionTitle: A friendly members' club with more to offer than most people realise
paragraphs: Situated opposite the Village Hall, we're a fantastic family club with a lot to offer — and as the village has grown, plenty of villagers still don't know we're here. We run family and single memberships, and welcome anyone looking for good company and a proper local.

We're signed up to Sky and BT Sport, with four screens showing three different fixtures at once — football, racing, whatever's on. Two pool tables, a dartboard and a jukebox keep the regulars happy, and children are always welcome with their parents.
